title: qxmd271: Full solution visible, buttons always on screen, clean phone header
body: On phones the whole solution now scrolls above the Previous / Check / Next buttons, and those buttons always stay on screen. The phone header no longer shows the Eng / Med / Def / Acad switcher twice, and Login and the power icon are no longer cut off. Also keeps the small exam logo, correct answer keys and cleaner math from qxmd269.
